A belief is a learned interpretation, not a diagnosis or your identity. You do not need to trace painful memories or find a single deepest belief. Pause or work with a therapist if reflection becomes overwhelming.

::: {#belief-explorer-app .skill-app data-practice-app="belief-explorer"}
Loading Assumptions & Core Beliefs Explorer...
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="A worked example"}
Rae notices a rule that a reliable person must always be available. They recall times when communicating a limit helped others plan. A more flexible position is that reliability can include honest notice about capacity.
:::

For repeated observations, use the [Core Belief Evidence Log](/tool-finder/core-belief-evidence-log/).
